People want to find out the creation of the world

bond

(noun). Sự nối ghép, sự liên kết, gắn, liên kết

Friendship is the bond between people

precise

(adjective). Rõ ràng, chính xác

We need to be precise when doing math

laughter

(noun). Sự cười, tiếng cười

Laughter can create happiness

indicate

(verb). Chỉ, cho biết, ra dấu

The graph indicates that the sales are growing

associate

(verb). kết hợp, liên hợp, liên kết

These are the things that associate with Christmas

evidence

(noun). chứng, chứng cớ, bằng chứng

They are looking for the evidence to find the killer

exclude

(verb). Loại trừ Đuổi tống ra, tống ra

The kids in class exclude him- they dont talk to him anymore

emphasise

(verb). Nhấn mạnh

This poster emphasises the importance of wearing masks

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp, rắc rối

This is a complex problem

definite

(adjective). Xác đinh, định rõ

He hasn't made the definite answer yet

harmless

(adjective). Không có hại, vô hại; không độc

This cat looks harmless- he is not dangerous at all

release

(verb). sự tách ra, sự nhả ra, sự giải phóng

Cars released polluted air

monitor

(verb). Giám sát

The doctor monitors the patient

respiration

(noun). Sự thở, sự hô hấp; hơi thở

His respiration was slow and difficult.

equivalent

(adjective). Tương đương

These two numbers are equivalent

pace of life

(noun). nhịp sống

People in the cities have a fast pace of life because they are busy

infection

(noun). Sự nhiễm, sự làm nhiễm độc, sự làm nhiễm trùng

Shaking hands can increase the chance of infection

immune system

(noun). hệ miễn dịch

She has a strong immune system- he doesn't get sick easily

comic

(adjective). Hài hước, khôi hài

"Friends" is a comic series

restorative

(verb). Làm hồi phục sức khoẻ; tẩm bổ

After a hard day at the office, a quick sleep is a restorative way to make you feel better
